decisions.reason: Booking-account and operational separation is already owned by the source Requirement; the candidate's existing same-message Event separately captures Seattle's disabled booking state and future activation without requiring another state change.

Separate backend accounts and operational data do not alter the reusable site-template state; the source message's distinct Seattle-template clause is already represented by the candidate's same-message Event.
Seattle's separate Wix account and backend operations remain compatible with the established master-site routing and location-site booking ownership without changing either attribute.
The source explicitly preserves a common customer-facing Smash Room brand while separating backend operations, so the shared visual-brand requirement remains valid unchanged.
Operational account and data isolation does not necessarily change the established visual style, layout characteristics, design reference, or brand impression.
Seattle's separate Wix account and backend operations do not change the master site's specified domain assignment.
